title: Shield and Shield Advanced: DDoS protection and what it costs

videos.script: Some attacks steal nothing. They send so much traffic that real customers cannot get in. {{flood}} There are two kinds. Floods of packets that fill the road, and floods of requests that look real and are expensive to answer. They are stopped in different places. {{two}} Every AWS account already has Shield Standard, for free, against the first kind. There is nothing to configure and nothing to see. {{standard}} The second kind is lesson fifteen's work: rate rules, managed rules, and a cache in front. {{waf}} Then there is Shield Advanced. It adds a response team, automatic rules during an attack, and money back for the scaling an attack causes. It costs three thousand dollars a month, for a year, and it cannot be cancelled. {{advanced}} You will subscribe in the lab, where it costs nothing, and read the terms as data. Then you will price it for the shop, and decide, with the numbers written down. For this shop, the answer is no. Knowing why is the lesson. {{decide}}
